title: AMQP 0-9-1 frame
summary: AMQP (Advanced Message Queuing Protocol) 0-9-1 frames: 1-byte type (1 method, 2 header, 3 body, 4 heartbeat), 2-byte channel (big-endian), 4-byte size (big-endian), payload, 1-byte frame end (0xCE). Method frames contain a class ID (2 bytes) and method ID (2 bytes) plus arguments.

structure.meaning: 1 method, 2 content header, 3 content body, 4 heartbeat, 8 (used by some implementations).

ext.example_decoded: AMQP method frame: type 1, channel 0, size 8, class 10 (connection), method 10 (start-ok)
notes: AMQP 0-9-1 is used by RabbitMQ (the most popular implementation).
AMQP 1.0 (OASIS standard) is a different protocol with a different frame format.
Channels multiplex multiple logical connections over a single TCP connection.
Content headers carry message properties (content type, delivery mode, priority, correlation ID, reply-to, expiration, etc.).
AMQP supports exchanges (direct, fanout, topic, headers) and queues with bindings.
